deploy: bash -euo pipefail -c 'set -a; source ./bosh.env; set +a; bosh create-release --force && bosh upload-release && release_manifest=$(ls -v dev_releases/juicefs/juicefs-*.yml | tail -n 1) && bosh update-config --type=runtime --name=juicefs -n runtime-config/juicefs-volume-driver.yml -v juicefs_release_version="$(bosh interpolate "$release_manifest" --path /version)" && bosh -n -d juicefs deploy manifests/juicefs.yml && bosh deploy -n -d cf <(bosh manifest -d cf) -o operations/enable-juicefs-cf-volume-service.yml'
vendor-go: bash -euo pipefail -c 'cd src/juicefs; go mod vendor; mkdir -p ../juicefs-deps; rm -rf ../juicefs-deps/vendor; mv vendor ../juicefs-deps/vendor'
